name: 65360 · Windsor, MO
findings: ZIP 65360 (Windsor) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65360 (Windsor) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
71% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
